Organization/Cluster scope funds return only for active members and never become a member's available PF cash

chosenApproach: Reuse private PF earnings and current QMP RPCs for per-user estimates/cash, show a single existing PF payout door, add one membership-protected read-only RPC for separate scope fund and mount a reusable Home widget in 3 existing paths. No modifications to withdrawal ledger and config gates.
selectionRationale: Existing canonical PF V3 already consolidates funded user pool, first-line and one-time referral rewards, with one withdrawal and payout identity; only cross-Home visibility and properly isolated scope fund read are missing. Replacing payout engine or treating noncash Rewards as cash risks double-credit.
alternativeApproaches: Move all points, AdMob estimates, scope treasury and referrals into one withdrawable balance: rejected as unfunded, inaccurate and financially unsafe.
Build parallel referral and revenue payout engines: rejected because canonical PF V3 already provides one idempotent available-cash withdrawal.
Reuse canonical funded cash wallet and add read-only personal/scope views across homes: chosen.
preserveBehaviors: Current 30% preliminary AdMob QMP estimate remains noncash and subject to freshness
